export_mephisto_db_data: export data from Mephisto DB to a JSON dump file with optional task filtering
import_mephisto_db_dump: import data from a previously exported dump file into the Mephisto DB
backup_mephisto_db: create a full backup of all Mephisto DB and provider-specific datastore data
restore_mephisto_db: restore all Mephisto DB data from a backup archive zip file
export_qualification_data: export only worker qualification data using the qualification-only flag
